description: Tests the LP-dual proton pair-knot composite (the #2467 fix direction + candidate for the open categorical brane-pairing invariant). The canonical H_3 operator-selection LP-dual is degenerate (single nucleon W_free=W_atom; A=2 pair H_6 intractable/degenerate, audit §7d), so a direct LP cannot isolate the invariant. The pair-knot composite (def:coulomb-charge Q_pp=+1, ratio tanh(ln q₀)=(q₀²−1)/(q₀²+1)) is the right object — it removes the spurious per-generator over-count (he3-tower-charge-asymmetry) and carries the correct-sign Coulomb (31%, charge_coulomb_tn3he_derived) — but the residual magnitude is the known-open, forbidden-to-fit gap. EXPLORATORY; scopes, does not close. No fit.
